rows.name: Maine Board of Licensure in Medicine
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Maine's physicians and physician assistants. Eleven members appointed by the Governor — six physicians, two physician assistants, and three public members (32 M.R.S. 3263).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Maine Revised Statutes; ME publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Maine Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Maine's real estate brokers and salespersons. Six members appointed by the Governor — four industry members and two public members (32 M.R.S. 13062).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Maine Revised Statutes; ME publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
